answer: Challenge-bound answer slots. Each agent identity must answer a fresh, randomly generated puzzle whose solution is a unique string tied to that identity's secret seed; the issuer verifies the string before granting the next puzzle, so a copied answer fails and cannot be reused. Like a fable with one ending, each reply exists once. Cost: an attacker must solve every puzzle independently, paying full compute per identity and losing any replay shortcut. A shared inlet of precomputed answers collapses; a willow of fake accounts must each do real work.
